findings.where: docs/demo-screenshots/10-about-quality-roadmap-375.png vs README.md row 10 and FACULTY_DEMO_SCRIPT.md section 5 item 10
findings.what: The caption (FR and EN) says 'Verified technically locally only. Content not biomedically validated. Roadmap: proposals, not agreements.' and the README says the shot is 'scrolled to the end of How quality is assured'. The image does not show the heading 'How quality is assured' (only the bottom edge of a previous card at the very top) and does not show any 'technically verified locally only' sentence. It shows the amber 'Not yet biomedically validated' card, 'Scientific validation roadmap / Planned, not done', and the first two roadmap cards (Create Monastir, Observe & Learn HEPL / Liège). The 'verified locally only' claim in the caption is therefore not supported by what is on the image.
findings.evidence: Visual read of the 750x1624 PNG (375x812 @2x). Top of image: sliver of a teal card, then the amber card. Heading 'How quality is assured' (web/src/pages/about.tsx:98) is not in frame.
findings.suggested_fix: Either re-crop/scroll 10 so the 'How quality is assured' heading and its 'verified locally only' line are visible, or reword the caption to only describe what is visible (not yet validated; roadmap planned, not done; proposals not agreements).

findings.what: Each mission row shows '17 of 38 students completed' next to a bar and '59%'. 17/38 = 45%, and Gram Stain shows '29 of 38' (76%) next to 65%. The data is correct (seed COMPLETED=[...,29,...,17] and COL_TARGET 59/64; the % is class mean accuracy on best attempts, per web/src/pages/faculty.tsx:134 bar-note), but the sentence that defines the percentage ('Success is the class mean accuracy...') sits below the fold and is cut off in this 900px viewport capture. On the image alone, 59% looks inconsistent with 17 of 38. The list itself is also cut mid-row at the bottom (third mission 'Anemia Detective' half visible).
findings.evidence: Rows 'Acid-Base Emergency 17 of 38 students completed ... 59%' and 'Gram Stain Challenge 29 of 38 students completed ... 65%'. be/src/demo.ts COMPLETED and COL_TARGET confirm 17/59 and 29/64(65 after rounding). faculty.tsx:134 holds the definition.
findings.suggested_fix: Retake 07 taller (about 1100 px) so the bar-note is visible, or add an inline 'success = class mean accuracy' label next to the percentage in the UI (UX fix, not screenshot-only).

findings.what: The card is titled 'Earned milestones' but lists 7 badges of which 3 are LOCKED (Microbiology Investigator, Biochemistry Analyst, Clinical Detective) and 4 EARNED. A viewer reads 'earned' for the whole list. Not an overclaim of validation, but the heading contradicts the content.
findings.evidence: Heading 'Earned milestones'; rows with gold 'EARNED' (Hematology Detective, First Escape, Perfect Mission, No Hint) and grey 'LOCKED' (3 rows).
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the heading to 'Milestones' or 'Badges (4 of 7 earned)'.
